messages.author: 3286fc25c6432b38
messages.subject: Possible bug in fromFiles.ChipEffectSet
parts:
Hi,

I was running into problems when loading fragment-length-normalised
data:

...
> fln <- FragmentLengthNormalization(ces)
> print(fln)

FragmentLengthNormalization:
Data set: HM
Input tags: QN,RMA,A+B
Output tags: QN,RMA,A+B,FLN
Number of arrays: 11 (105.12MB)
Chip type: Mapping250K_Nsp,monocell
Algorithm parameters: (subsetToFit: NULL, .targetFunction: NULL)
Output path: plmData/HM,QN,RMA,A+B,FLN/Mapping250K_Nsp
Is done: TRUE
RAM: 0.00MB

> cesN <- process(fln, verbose=log)

Error in fromFiles.AffymetrixCelSet(static, path = path, pattern =
pattern, :
formal argument "checkChipType" matched by multiple actual
arguments

> traceback()

11: fromFiles.AffymetrixCelSet(static, path = path, pattern =
pattern,
..., fileClass = fileClass, checkChipType = FALSE)
10: fromFiles.ChipEffectSet(static, ..., mergeStrands = mergeStrands)
9: fromFiles.SnpChipEffectSet(static, ..., combineAlleles =
combineAlleles)
8: method(static, ...)
7: clazz$fromFiles(path = getPath(this), checkChipType = FALSE)
6: getOutputDataSet.Transform(this)
5: NextMethod(generic = "getOutputDataSet", object = this, ...)
4: getOutputDataSet.FragmentLengthNormalization(this)
3: getOutputDataSet(this)
2: process.FragmentLengthNormalization(fln, verbose = log,
checkChipType = FALSE)
1: process(fln, verbose = log, checkChipType = FALSE)

> sessionInfo()
R version 2.5.0 (2007-04-23)
x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
...
attached base packages:
[1] "splines" "tools" "stats" "graphics" "grDevices"
"utils"
[7] "datasets" "methods" "base"

other attached packages:
GLAD aws aroma.affymetrix digest
"1.10.0" "1.3-2" "0.5.2" "0.3.0"
aroma.apd R.huge aroma.light affyPLM
"0.1.3" "0.1.4" "1.4.1" "1.12.0"
gcrma matchprobes affydata affy
"2.8.1" "1.8.1" "1.11.2" "1.14.1"
affyio Biobase affxparser R.native
"1.4.0" "1.14.0" "1.8.0" "0.1.2"
R.rsp R.cache R.utils R.oo
"0.3.3" "0.1.5" "0.9.5" "1.2.8"

I think the problem arose in 'fromFiles.ChipEffectSet', because the
argument 'checkChipType' is passed to 'fromFiles.AffymetrixCelSet'
twice, once when
'clazz$fromFiles(path = getPath(this), checkChipType = FALSE)'
is called by 'getOutputDataSet.Transform', and once from
'fromFiles.ChipEffectSet'. The former is wrapped up in the '...'
argument and the latter is explicit.

When I added 'checkChipType' as an argument, it all worked OK :

setMethodS3("fromFiles", "ChipEffectSet", function(static,
path="plmData/", pattern=",chipEffects[.](c|C)(e|E)(l|L)
$", ...,checkChipType = FALSE, fileClass=NULL) {
# Argument 'fileClass':
if (is.null(fileClass))
fileClass <- gsub("Set$", "File", class(static)[1]);

# Unfortunately does method dispatching not work here.
fromFiles.AffymetrixCelSet(static, path=path, pattern=pattern, ...,
fileClass=fileClass, checkChipType=checkChipType);
}, static=TRUE)


> cesN <- process(fln, verbose=log)
> print(cesN)
CnChipEffectSet:
Name: HM
Tags: QN,RMA,A+B,FLN
Path: plmData/HM,QN,RMA,A+B,FLN/Mapping250K_Nsp
Chip type: Mapping250K_Nsp,monocell
Number of arrays: 11
Names: 1344_12, 1344_13, ..., 1420_9
Time period: 2007-06-30 16:11:41 -- 2007-06-30 16:11:42
Total file size: 105.12MB
RAM: 0.02MB
Parameters: (probeModel: chr "pm", mergeStrands: logi TRUE,
combineAlleles: logi TRUE)

Otherwise things have been running smoothly so far with this version.

Thanks,

Jeremy

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Possible bug in fromFiles.ChipEffectSet
parts:
Hi Jeremy,

thanks for this. Your troubleshooting is indeed correct, and your bug
fix works. The fix will be available in the next release. In the
meantime, download & install the patch by:

library(aroma.affymetrix)
downloadPackagePatch("aroma.affymetrix")

Cheers

Henrik
